cohort: 428 neonatal infants admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) of Ohta Nishinouchi Hospital, Japan, between April 1, 2016 and July 31, 2019.
finding: Neonatal reticulocyte count was significantly associated with gestational age at birth, mode of delivery, maternal haemoglobin before delivery, tracheal intubation at resuscitation, and mean platelet volume.
mod_finding: Neonatal reticulocyte count was significantly lower in infants born by cesarean section (OR 0.51, 95% CI 0.28-0.95).
